signals.summary: Abacum provides AI-native FP&A software for financial services and fintech to control cost-to-income and plan headcount, entities, and currencies.
signals.evidence: FP&A for financial services. Control cost-to-income as the book grows. Plan headcount, entities, and currencies in one model

signals.summary: Abacum integrates with data tools such as Snowflake, BigQuery, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct to pull actuals continuously.
signals.evidence: Abacum connects to Snowflake, BigQuery, NetSuite and Sage Intacct, and pulls actuals continuously.

signals.summary: Abacum features AI Modeler for creating financial models using plain language without formulas.
signals.evidence: Meet AI Modeler: financial models in plain language. No formulas needed.
